The '''Velga Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that started at [[Velga Prime]] in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], and passed through [[Q'mara]] before heading out into the [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]].
